blocks.html: This reference shows all the events emitted by the Medusa application related to the Cart Module. If you use the module outside the Medusa application, these events aren't emitted.

events.name: cart.created
events.description: Emitted when a cart is created.

events.name: cart.updated
events.description: Emitted when a cart's details are updated.

events.name: cart.region_updated
events.description:
Emitted when the cart's region is updated. This
event is emitted alongside the `cart.updated` event.

events.name: cart.customer_transferred
events.description: Emitted when the customer in the cart is transferred.
